title: Where do you find or generate your assets for your games?
author: InsidiousToilet
selftext:
I've been dabbling in game dev off and on for nearly two decades now, and the one thing that always trips me up and pushes me away from a project is finding assets that aren't going to break the bank.  

With AI, we can have it do all sorts of work for us in game dev, but the only thing I've found so far were credits-based pixel art movement generators to animate a sprite, etc.  When I tested it, the prompt wasn't really making what I'd like it to, so I had ChatGPT make it, and then would feed *that* into the animator, and would get something workable (sometimes).

I'm just wondering what else is out there.  I'm at the point where I need to snag some assets and asking ChatGPT to make them for me is my best option.

comments.author: Legitimate-Paint2165
comments.body: I use Synty Studio assets. $40/m but the first payment needs to be 3 months upfront so $120 for 3 months then $40 after.

replies.author: Legitimate-Paint2165
replies.body: Yes but they don't allow gen AI (can't use their assets to generate assets with AI). So anything they make, or any edits you make, are fine - but using their assets to generate new assets isn't.

replies.author: Legitimate-Paint2165
replies.body: INAL but I would publicly say you can't while privately doing whatever.

comments.author: SeaThePirate
comments.body:
common mistake is that the AI can make everything for you - it cant. Even if its made giant leaps, your best bet if you want to save money is to look all over for free assets

there are TONS and i mean TONS of amazing free assets all over the place

some hubs you can look up with search bars to look up for anything you need

Fab

Itchio

Sketchfab

These three have everything, but there's also more specific websites like Mixamo which are just ALL animations

replies.author: InsidiousToilet
replies.body:
Hell yea, thank you so much!

I get it though.  I'm a software engineer and tell my devs that all the time.  AI is just a tool, but it can't do it all for you (at least not well).  

I'll give those a look when I boot everything up tonight!

replies.author: InsidiousToilet
replies.body: Interesting, I'd seen the commercial for it, but haven't checked it out yet.  I've just been using 5.6 Sol to check my code in the browser, lol.

replies.author: SomnambulisticTaco
replies.body: Adding to this, headless blender works well, but blender MCP works great.

comments.body: I had 1 solution for me . You can try Video generators from image Like Google Flow , and  Use GREEN background . when you got your aniamtion as green back ground video , CAHTGPT can turn it into sprite sheet and remove green background .

replies.author: InsidiousToilet
replies.body: Do you have a prompt that you can share?  I was able to get ChatGPT to extract the frames, and told it to remove the background, but it's only partially removed it...most of it is still there, lol.  I can't seem to tell it what to do properly.
